item.title: [UI & Layout] Smart Friction UI System
item.description: Users respond better to guidance than hard blocks. This system leverages subtle visual and motion cues to create 'smart friction,' guiding user behavior without frustration. Ensure assets scale perfectly for 16px favicons and use a 4px 'quiet zone' for any integrated QR codes, maintaining optimal scannability.
